USCIS Developer Portal (Case Status API).how_to_join: Founder's developer.uscis.gov team 'agl_developersupport' (created 2026-10-14) → register an app under the team → request Case Status API access
USCIS Developer Portal (Case Status API).where_credential: Developer portal → My Apps → your app → client ID / secret (sandbox first; production after USCIS approves the use case)
USCIS Developer Portal (Case Status API).what_to_submit: App name and description (Uscis-Case), use case (show a user their own case status by receipt number), privacy policy URL https://www.americangroup.ai/policy/uscis-case-tracker/, company details
USCIS Developer Portal (Case Status API).what_you_receive: OAuth2 client ID + client secret (sandbox, then production)
USCIS Developer Portal (Case Status API).where_it_goes: Supabase Edge Function secrets (uscis-case-status) — never in the app, chat or git
USCIS Developer Portal (Case Status API).approval: Sandbox on registration; production after USCIS review (verify)
USCIS Developer Portal (Case Status API).notes: Team agl_developersupport exists (founder, 2026-10-14; page requires sign-in — HTTP 403 to an anonymous check). Next: register the Uscis-Case app under the team, request Case Status (and FOIA, if listed) API access, then put the sandbox client ID/secret into Supabase Edge Function secrets. Spec: ai-office/projects/real-apps/specs/Uscis-Case-v2.md. Portal username stays in the founder vault.

USCIS FOIA.how_to_join: Official USCIS FOIA portal; check developer.uscis.gov for a FOIA API
USCIS FOIA.where_credential: If an API exists: developer portal app credentials; otherwise none (user files on the official portal)
USCIS FOIA.where_it_goes: Supabase Edge Function secret if an API exists
